integrity: All conclusions are based on the included analytic proof. Finite-support code corroborates but cannot establish infinite-dimensional assertions; no independent verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is a sufficient criterion; exact threshold is only for the described family, and the cardinal dichotomy is only for ell-infinity summands. Classical shift constructions may entail an overlooked equivalent formulation.
title: A basis-free expansive automorphism on Banach–sequence product spaces with a sharp scalar boundary
